create_ExponentialMovingAverage_with_dec: create an ExponentialMovingAverage module with a decay rate between 0 and 1 for smoothing values
test_ExponentialMovingAverage_warmup: test the ExponentialMovingAverage warmup_length parameter to delay EMA updates for the first N calls
create_EMAParamsTree_for_params: create an EMAParamsTree module to apply exponential moving averages across a Haiku params tree
test_EMAParamsTree_ignore_regex: test the EMAParamsTree ignore_regex parameter to exclude specific parameters from having EMA applied
run_ExponentialMovingAverage_without_upd: run the ExponentialMovingAverage call with update_stats=False to read the average without modifying internal state
